speaker: davy_gannet
text: Bankside. The Rose goes by with the flagstaff bare. A dark house does not need a sermon.

speaker: james_burbage
text: I did not come for the Rose. I came for the next roof.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The first time on the river since May. I am looking. I am not stepping out.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Looking is what the boat is for. The bank can keep its mud.

speaker: james_burbage
text: There. Green oak. It'll twist.

speaker: james_burbage
text: It's bigger than mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Wider than the Rose from here, and wider than the Theatre. I have the eye for that. You have the trade.

speaker: james_burbage
text: The trade says green oak moves. A ring this wide will shift a door before the thatch is old. They are raising it anyway.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: The Lord Mayor wrote to my Lord Treasurer against this very house last November. And there it stands, on ground the City cannot touch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A letter, and the posts still going in. That is the part I understand.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: That's Langley's. A goldsmith building a playhouse, master. He'll gild the groundlings.

speaker: james_burbage
text: A goldsmith. I asked for a builder. The oak does not care what the other shop sells.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Gold or oak, the letter did not stop a post. I am not writing a second letter from this thwart to comfort the first.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A goldsmith, and letters written against him. That is what I know from this boat. I am not landing to learn a third thing.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: No landing. The wherry holds the four of us. You look, and I pull, and the timber stays where it is.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Pull slower along the long side. I want the bays. A man can miscount a ring from a moving thwart.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Count them. Do not ask me to love them. Bigger than ours is not better until it has taken a penny.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No penny of mine is in that ring. The share was said at the Theatre. It is not a stake in his oak.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Hold for the long side. When you look back, the Rose's flagstaff is still bare.

speaker: james_burbage
text: This one has timber enough. Green, and wet, and too wide. I have seen what I came to see.

speaker: cuthbert_burbage
text: Then we have seen it. The City cannot touch the ground, and the ground is doing without the City.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seen, and not stepped on. I want the one look, not a second tour.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: The timber can twist without a second audience in the thwarts.

speaker: james_burbage
text: One look was the errand. Green oak. It'll twist. I have said it twice because it is still true.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twice is enough. The ring is the picture. The rest of the water is the way back.
